name: Granulosa cell
short_description: Small cuboidal-to-columnar epithelial cell that forms the wall of the ovarian follicle around the maturing oocyte, nurses it via gap junctions, and converts theca-cell androgens into estrogen; after ovulation it becomes part of the corpus luteum.
